{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:United States|United States]]

'''Tomato pie''' is a type of [[Cookbook:Pizza|pizza]], a food that is popular in Italy and the north east USA. Sometimes mistakenly considered an American dish, it is commonly found in bakeries throughout Italy and other countries, where it is simply called [[Cookbook:Pizza|pizza]] and is often bought and consumed on the spot. It is generally made with canned tomatoes. In the USA, it is usually served at room temperature, but many bakeries, where it is often bought as fast food, will reheat slices upon request.

Many bakeries and pizzerias have their own variation on the basic recipe. The basic recipe features thick pizza dough covered with a thick tomato sauce. After cooking the pizza is sprinkled with grated Romano cheese.

==Ingredients==
* ¾ [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] [[Cookbook:Mozzarella Cheese|mozzarella cheese]], [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|extra-virgin olive oil]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Clove|cloves]] [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
* 1 large can [[Cookbook:Tomato|crushed tomatoes]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] dried [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]] 
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] (450 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) pizza dough
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] grated [[Cookbook:Pecorino Romano Cheese|Pecorino Romano cheese]]

== Procedure ==
#Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven Temperatures|250°C]] (450°F). 
#Stretch the pizza dough to cover a greased [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheet]]. Dough should be about 3 cm (¾ inch) thick.
#Allow the dough to rise while the sauce is prepared.
#Heat a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] on medium heat, add the olive oil and garlic. 
#[[Cookbook:Saute|Sauté]] until garlic is just golden. 
#Add crushed tomatoes and oregano.
#Cook until the sauce is thickened, about 15–20 minutes.
#Cool the sauce until it is room temperature. 
#Top the pizza dough with mozzarella cheese, then any toppings such as sausage or pepperoni, then top with sauce, [[Cookbook:Baking|bake]] in the oven for about 15–20 minutes.
#After removing the tomato-pie from the oven, sprinkle the grated cheese on top and then let the pizza cool to room temperature.
#Serve at room temperature or reheat under the [[Cookbook:Broiling|broiler]] or in a [[Cookbook:Toaster Oven|toaster-oven]].
== See also ==
* [[Cookbook:Pizza|Pizza]]
* [[Cookbook:Veggie Pizza|Veggie Pizza]]

steps.text: Preheat oven to 250°C (450°F).
Stretch the pizza dough to cover a greased baking sheet. Dough should be about 3 cm (¾ inch) thick.
Allow the dough to rise while the sauce is prepared.
Heat a saucepan on medium heat, add the olive oil and garlic.
Sauté until garlic is just golden.
Add crushed tomatoes and oregano.
Cook until the sauce is thickened, about 15–20 minutes.
Cool the sauce until it is room temperature.
Top the pizza dough with mozzarella cheese, then any toppings such as sausage or pepperoni, then top with sauce, bake in the oven for about 15–20 minutes.
After removing the tomato-pie from the oven, sprinkle the grated cheese on top and then let the pizza cool to room temperature.
Serve at room temperature or reheat under the broiler or in a toaster-oven.
